organizations.name: GHGSat
organizations.tagline: Measuring methane emissions from space, and from aircraft.

description.text: GHGSat describes itself as a greenhouse gas emissions intelligence company. It uses its own satellites and aircraft to measure methane from industrial sites around the world. It says it has launched 16 satellites.

organizations.name: Wilder Institute
organizations.tagline: Conservation research and animal care, working together for wildlife.

description.text: Wilder describes itself as a global conservation charity bringing together conservation, animal care and public engagement. Its work includes the Calgary Zoo and species recovery programs.

beneficiaries.text: At-risk wildlife and the people and communities working to conserve it. In the owl program, landowners help provide release sites on prairie grasslands.

organizations.name: E3 Lithium
organizations.tagline: Developing a route from Alberta brine to battery-grade lithium carbonate.

description.text: E3 Lithium is developing the Clearwater lithium project in Alberta. It is using demonstration operations and engineering studies to develop a commercial facility.

offering.text: A planned supply of battery-grade lithium carbonate from Alberta brine. This is a development project, not an operating commercial plant.

beneficiaries.text: Prospective battery-material customers. E3 reports discussions and non-binding agreements with potential supply partners; these are not completed sales.

headquarters.text: Calgary, Alberta.

localConnection.text: Clearwater lies between Calgary and Red Deer. The operator job example is for the demonstration facility east of Olds and Didsbury; the engineering posting is based in Calgary.

roles.explanation: Build a sequence from selected footage to communicate a coherent idea.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Review and organize available footage.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Choose cuts, order and timing for the intended story.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Check continuity and revise against feedback.

collaborators: Directors, producers, colourists and sound teams
roles.classroomConnection: Sequence can change interpretation even when the individual images stay the same.

roles.title: Colour finishing
roles.summary: Work on the appearance and consistency of images during post-production.
roles.explanation: Work on the appearance and consistency of images during post-production.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Compare shots using the agreed visual reference.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Adjust recorded colour and tonal relationships.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Check the sequence and deliverable with the production team.

roles.classroomConnection: Changing the appearance of an image is different from changing the original event.

roles.title: Ingredient and formulation science
roles.summary: Investigate how ingredients behave in a product. This work connects a material’s composition to properties such as texture, stability or performance in a mixture.
roles.explanation: Investigate how ingredients behave in a product. This work connects a material’s composition to properties such as texture, stability or performance in a mixture.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose a property to compare across formulations.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Prepare controlled trials and observe changes over time.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain the trade-offs between ingredients and processing conditions.

collaborators: Biochemists, laboratory technicians and product-development teams
roles.classroomConnection: Molecules and mixtures help explain why two ingredients can behave differently.

roles.title: Laboratory analysis
roles.summary: Make measurements that other people can trust. A laboratory worker prepares samples, uses a method consistently and records enough detail for someone else to interpret the result.
roles.explanation: Make measurements that other people can trust. A laboratory worker prepares samples, uses a method consistently and records enough detail for someone else to interpret the result.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare and label samples so their identity is preserved.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Run comparisons or reference samples to check the method.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record results, units and limitations before sharing findings.

collaborators: Scientists, process engineers and quality teams
roles.classroomConnection: A repeatable method and a fair comparison matter as much as a single impressive number.

roles.title: Process engineering
roles.summary: Turn a useful transformation into a workable sequence of equipment and operating steps. Process engineers consider what enters, what leaves and what conditions the system must maintain.
roles.explanation: Turn a useful transformation into a workable sequence of equipment and operating steps. Process engineers consider what enters, what leaves and what conditions the system must maintain.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Draw a flow of materials and energy through the system.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare operating conditions and equipment options.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Use trial results to revise the process and communicate constraints.

collaborators: Laboratory staff, operators, mechanical designers and controls specialists
roles.classroomConnection: Conservation of matter and energy connects classroom calculations to process decisions.

roles.title: Instrument development and testing
roles.summary: Help build and check the equipment that produces measurements. Instrument work joins hardware, software and experiments rather than treating a reading as automatically correct.
roles.explanation: Help build and check the equipment that produces measurements. Instrument work joins hardware, software and experiments rather than treating a reading as automatically correct.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check performance using a known reference.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Investigate drift, noise or inconsistent readings.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Document tests so later users know what the instrument can establish.

collaborators: Scientists, electronics specialists and software developers
roles.classroomConnection: Measurement uncertainty is part of using a tool responsibly.

roles.title: Scientific applications
roles.summary: Connect an instrument to the question a user needs to answer. Applications work involves selecting a method, interpreting results and explaining limitations.
roles.explanation: Connect an instrument to the question a user needs to answer. Applications work involves selecting a method, interpreting results and explaining limitations.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose a measurement approach for the sample.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare outputs with reference information.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain what further tests would resolve ambiguity.

collaborators: Laboratory users, instrument engineers and researchers
roles.classroomConnection: A pattern is evidence to interpret, not a label that proves an answer by itself.

roles.title: Software and data systems
roles.summary: Build the tools that move, process and display information. Reliable software needs testing against missing, delayed and unexpected data as well as ideal examples.
roles.explanation: Build the tools that move, process and display information. Reliable software needs testing against missing, delayed and unexpected data as well as ideal examples.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Translate a user need into a testable behaviour.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Build and test a data-processing or display feature.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate failures and document assumptions about inputs.

collaborators: Domain experts, designers, users and hardware teams
roles.classroomConnection: An algorithm’s output depends on the quality and meaning of its inputs.

roles.title: Mechanical design and prototyping
roles.summary: Translate a need into a component or machine that can be built and tested. Designers use dimensions, material properties and constraints to evaluate alternatives.
roles.explanation: Translate a need into a component or machine that can be built and tested. Designers use dimensions, material properties and constraints to evaluate alternatives.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Create and revise drawings or a digital model.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Choose materials and dimensions for the intended conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Compare the prototype with its requirements and refine the design.

collaborators: Machinists, fabricators, test staff and customers
roles.classroomConnection: Geometry, forces and material properties shape real design trade-offs.

roles.title: Machining and dimensional inspection
roles.summary: Make parts fit their intended purpose by controlling dimensions. Machining combines tools, setup and measurement; finishing a part is not the same as proving it meets its specification.
roles.explanation: Make parts fit their intended purpose by controlling dimensions. Machining combines tools, setup and measurement; finishing a part is not the same as proving it meets its specification.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Interpret a drawing and plan a sequence of cuts.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Set up the machine and check the workpiece.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Measure critical dimensions and document deviations.

collaborators: Designers, production teams and quality inspectors
roles.classroomConnection: Tolerance describes an acceptable range rather than a perfectly exact number.

roles.title: Quality and traceability
roles.summary: Make it possible to explain how a result or product was produced. Quality work checks records, methods and acceptance criteria so variation can be investigated rather than hidden.
roles.explanation: Make it possible to explain how a result or product was produced. Quality work checks records, methods and acceptance criteria so variation can be investigated rather than hidden.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check that materials and samples have traceable identities.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare recorded results with defined acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate deviations and document what changed.

collaborators: Production, laboratory, engineering and customer teams
roles.classroomConnection: Repeated results need both measurements and records of the conditions that produced them.

roles.title: Instrumentation and controls
roles.summary: Keep a process measurable and responsive. Controls work connects sensors, decisions and actuators so the system can respond when conditions change.
roles.explanation: Keep a process measurable and responsive. Controls work connects sensors, decisions and actuators so the system can respond when conditions change.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check whether sensors are reading reliably.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare measurements with the intended operating range.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Test how the system responds to a change or fault.

roles.classroomConnection: Feedback uses a measured result to inform the next action.

roles.title: Aircraft maintenance
roles.summary: Investigate condition, carry out authorized maintenance and preserve the records behind a decision. Aircraft maintenance work relies on approved procedures and appropriate qualifications.
roles.explanation: Investigate condition, carry out authorized maintenance and preserve the records behind a decision. Aircraft maintenance work relies on approved procedures and appropriate qualifications.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Inspect a component using the applicable procedure.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare findings with documented limits and escalate uncertainty.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record work and test results for the maintenance decision.

collaborators: Licensed AMEs, avionics specialists, engineering and quality teams
roles.classroomConnection: A visual impression alone is not enough evidence that a part is safe.

roles.title: Avionics and electronics
roles.summary: Work on the electronic systems that allow aircraft to communicate, navigate and collect data. Troubleshooting means distinguishing a faulty sensor from wiring, power or software problems.
roles.explanation: Work on the electronic systems that allow aircraft to communicate, navigate and collect data. Troubleshooting means distinguishing a faulty sensor from wiring, power or software problems.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Trace a signal through connected components.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Use test equipment to compare expected and measured behaviour.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Document the fault and verify the result after authorized work.

collaborators: Aircraft maintenance teams, electrical designers and software developers
roles.classroomConnection: Circuits and signals become useful when the complete system works reliably.

roles.title: Bioprocess development
roles.summary: Develop repeatable ways to make and purify biological materials. This work connects molecular science to manufacturing conditions and checks whether a change improves the process.
roles.explanation: Develop repeatable ways to make and purify biological materials. This work connects molecular science to manufacturing conditions and checks whether a change improves the process.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Define a comparison between process conditions.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Track production and purification steps for each batch.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Use analytical results to decide which change to test next.

collaborators: Molecular scientists, analytical staff and quality teams
roles.classroomConnection: Knowing a sequence or molecule is different from producing a reliable batch of it.

roles.title: Drone operations
roles.summary: Plan and carry out flights for a specific task while coordinating with the people responsible for the site. The aircraft is one tool within an operational plan.
roles.explanation: Plan and carry out flights for a specific task while coordinating with the people responsible for the site. The aircraft is one tool within an operational plan.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Review the task, site and operating constraints.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Check the aircraft and coordinate the flight with relevant personnel.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record observations and equipment issues after the flight.

collaborators: Site operations, wildlife specialists and data analysts
roles.classroomConnection: Flight performance must be considered alongside the task and the surrounding environment.

roles.title: Wildlife monitoring and interpretation
roles.summary: Observe how animals respond to an intervention and ask whether the change lasts. This work needs consistent observations and attention to other causes of changing behaviour.
roles.explanation: Observe how animals respond to an intervention and ask whether the change lasts. This work needs consistent observations and attention to other causes of changing behaviour.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Define how bird activity will be counted.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare observations before and after an intervention.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record weather, season and other factors that could explain a difference.

collaborators: Drone operators, airport staff and environmental teams
roles.classroomConnection: Behavioural response is evidence; reduced sightings alone do not prove a lasting safety outcome.

roles.title: Spatial data and mapping
roles.summary: Turn measurements tied to places into usable spatial information. The work involves coordinates, scale and checking that datasets describe the same location and time.
roles.explanation: Turn measurements tied to places into usable spatial information. The work involves coordinates, scale and checking that datasets describe the same location and time.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check coordinate systems and measurement dates.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Align and inspect spatial datasets.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Present maps or models with their limitations.

collaborators: Surveyors, engineers, field operators and software teams
roles.classroomConnection: Models can be detailed while still containing gaps or misaligned measurements.

roles.title: Geoscience and interpretation
roles.summary: Explain what rock measurements suggest about geology. Geoscientists combine observations with context and use additional tests where a scan leaves uncertainty.
roles.explanation: Explain what rock measurements suggest about geology. Geoscientists combine observations with context and use additional tests where a scan leaves uncertainty.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Describe core and identify changes along it.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare sensor patterns with geological observations or assays.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Communicate alternative interpretations and uncertainty.

collaborators: Core technicians, data scientists and exploration teams
roles.classroomConnection: A measurement of a sample is not automatically a measurement of the whole deposit.

roles.title: Industrial machinery assembly and maintenance
roles.summary: Make machinery work together as a physical system. Millwright work connects assembly, alignment, inspection and troubleshooting.
roles.explanation: Make machinery work together as a physical system. Millwright work connects assembly, alignment, inspection and troubleshooting.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Read equipment drawings and plan assembly steps.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Align and connect mechanical components.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Check operation and record problems that need adjustment.

collaborators: Designers, operators, electricians and fabrication teams
roles.classroomConnection: Small alignment errors can change how forces and motion pass through a machine.

roles.title: Metal fabrication and welding
roles.summary: Join and assemble material into usable structures. Fabrication work follows drawings and procedures, then checks whether the finished work meets its requirements.
roles.explanation: Join and assemble material into usable structures. Fabrication work follows drawings and procedures, then checks whether the finished work meets its requirements.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Read dimensions and prepare components.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Use the specified joining process and sequence.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Inspect the assembly and communicate any deviation.

roles.classroomConnection: Material properties and heat affect the result of a joining process.

roles.title: Materials research and testing
roles.summary: Investigate whether a material improves a product for a defined purpose. A useful comparison separates the effect of the added material from other changes in the test.
roles.explanation: Investigate whether a material improves a product for a defined purpose. A useful comparison separates the effect of the added material from other changes in the test.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare comparable samples with and without an additive.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Measure a relevant property under consistent conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain performance changes alongside uncertainty and practical constraints.

collaborators: Chemists, process engineers and product developers
roles.classroomConnection: Stronger, lighter and more conductive are different properties requiring different tests.

roles.title: Power-electronics design
roles.summary: Control how electrical energy moves between components. Power-electronics work combines circuit design with testing, thermal limits and the behaviour of the complete system.
roles.explanation: Control how electrical energy moves between components. Power-electronics work combines circuit design with testing, thermal limits and the behaviour of the complete system.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose and document a circuit design.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Test its response across operating conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate losses and component limits before revising the design.

collaborators: Electrical technologists, firmware developers and manufacturing teams
roles.classroomConnection: Power describes the rate of energy transfer; stored energy describes how much is available.

roles.title: Weather-data interpretation
roles.summary: Use observations to understand changing atmospheric conditions. Weather-data work checks where and when a measurement was made before combining it with other evidence.
roles.explanation: Use observations to understand changing atmospheric conditions. Weather-data work checks where and when a measurement was made before combining it with other evidence.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check the position, time and quality of observations.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare measurements across altitude or time.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Identify gaps and explain how they limit an interpretation.

collaborators: Meteorologists, instrument teams and data engineers
roles.classroomConnection: More measurements can help, but uneven coverage can still leave important gaps.

roles.title: Atmospheric science and remote sensing
roles.summary: Turn light measurements into an explanation of what is in the air.
roles.explanation: Atmospheric and remote sensing scientists study how light travels through the air and what it can reveal. In methane monitoring, they decide whether a signal is real, estimate how much gas it represents, and say how certain they are.

tasks.title: Check the signal
tasks.detail: Decide whether a measurement is reliable, or caused by something else such as cloud or a bright surface.

tasks.title: Build an estimate
tasks.detail: Use models and wind information to turn an absorption signal into a rate of emission.

tasks.title: Share the findings
tasks.detail: Explain results, and their uncertainty, to people who make decisions.

roles.classroomConnection: Wavelength, absorption and measurement uncertainty all show up in this work.

roles.title: Satellite and instrument engineering
roles.summary: Design, build and test the instruments and spacecraft that take the measurements.
roles.explanation: Instrument and satellite engineers make the hardware that collects the light. They fit a precise optical instrument into a small spacecraft, then test and calibrate it so its readings can be trusted in orbit.

tasks.title: Design the instrument
tasks.detail: Choose optics and detectors that can pick out the wavelengths methane absorbs.

tasks.title: Test and calibrate
tasks.detail: Check on the ground that the instrument measures what it should, using known light sources.

tasks.title: Support it in orbit
tasks.detail: Monitor performance after launch and help fix problems from the ground.

roles.classroomConnection: Interference, wavelength and the behaviour of light are what make a spectrometer work.

roles.title: Software and data
roles.summary: Turn satellite measurements into data and tools people can use.
roles.explanation: Software developers and data specialists move measurements from the satellite to the people who need them. They build the systems that process large amounts of data and the web tools customers use to see where emissions are.

tasks.title: Build data pipelines
tasks.detail: Process large numbers of observations reliably and quickly.

tasks.title: Build tools for users
tasks.detail: Create web platforms and interfaces that let customers find and use results.

tasks.title: Find patterns
tasks.detail: Use statistics and machine learning to sort sites and spot changes over time.

roles.classroomConnection: A measurement only helps if people can find it, trust it and understand what it means.

roles.title: Conservation research and population ecology
roles.summary: Find out whether an intervention helps a wild population recover.
roles.explanation: Conservation researchers connect observations of individual animals to changes in a population. They plan what to measure, compare outcomes and explain what the evidence can and cannot establish.

tasks.title: Plan a comparison
tasks.detail: Choose measures of survival, breeding and population change, and decide what to compare them with.

tasks.title: Follow animals after release
tasks.detail: Record observations over time, accounting for animals that are difficult to detect.

tasks.title: Interpret the evidence
tasks.detail: Ask whether results reflect the intervention, environmental conditions or other explanations.

roles.classroomConnection: Survival and reproduction at different life stages affect population change. A successful release alone does not establish population recovery.

roles.title: Animal care and welfare
roles.summary: Support animals day to day and notice changes that matter.
roles.explanation: Animal care teams provide food, maintain habitats and observe behaviour and body condition. Care records help the team respond to changes and support conservation work without treating every species as if it has the same needs.

tasks.title: Provide daily care
tasks.detail: Follow prescribed diets and maintain clean, suitable habitats.

tasks.title: Observe and record
tasks.detail: Track behaviour, weight and body condition, and report changes to the team.

tasks.title: Work with specialists
tasks.detail: Support veterinary procedures and enrichment under established welfare and safety protocols.

roles.classroomConnection: Individual health and behaviour influence survival. Daily observations provide evidence, while population outcomes require follow-up beyond care.

roles.title: Veterinary care for wildlife
roles.summary: Assess animal health and support safe care and release.
roles.explanation: Veterinarians bring medical knowledge to animal care. In conservation settings, decisions about individual animals also need to consider the welfare of other animals and the risks associated with moving or releasing wildlife.

tasks.title: Assess health
tasks.detail: Examine animals and interpret observations or diagnostic tests.

tasks.title: Plan treatment
tasks.detail: Choose appropriate care and work with the animal-care team to monitor the response.

tasks.title: Support conservation decisions
tasks.detail: Contribute health and welfare evidence to decisions about care, transport and release.

roles.classroomConnection: The health of an individual and the recovery of a population are related questions, but they require different evidence.

roles.title: Process engineering
roles.summary: Design and test the steps that separate useful materials from a mixture.
roles.explanation: Process engineers connect chemistry to equipment and operating conditions. They use calculations, models and test results to decide how a process should work, then help troubleshoot what happens when it is scaled up.

tasks.title: Compare separation steps
tasks.detail: Evaluate how different treatment stages affect recovery, purity and resource use.

tasks.title: Check the balances
tasks.detail: Account for material entering and leaving each stage, using models and measurements.

tasks.title: Test and improve
tasks.detail: Use pilot or demonstration results to improve designs and support commissioning.

roles.classroomConnection: Concentration, mixtures and quantitative chemical change become practical questions about recovery, purity, water use and scale.

roles.title: Process and plant operations
roles.summary: Keep processing equipment running safely and learn from its measurements.
roles.explanation: Operators put a process into practice. They inspect equipment, record operating conditions and work with engineers and maintenance teams when results differ from what was expected.

tasks.title: Monitor the process
tasks.detail: Take readings and inspect equipment for signs of unusual behaviour.

tasks.title: Keep useful records
tasks.detail: Document conditions and events so results can be compared across shifts and tests.

tasks.title: Troubleshoot safely
tasks.detail: Report problems, support maintenance and help with commissioning or start-up work.

roles.classroomConnection: A separation method must work repeatedly. Careful measurements help explain why performance changes between trials.

roles.title: Business development and partnerships
roles.summary: Connect technical capabilities with the people who can use them.
roles.explanation: Business development teams learn what customers need and work with technical colleagues to explain what a service can deliver. Government-facing work also involves proposals, procurement requirements and coordinated project delivery.

tasks.title: Understand the need
tasks.detail: Identify customer problems and assess whether the technology can help.

tasks.title: Build a proposal
tasks.detail: Translate scientific capabilities into a clear offer, coordinating technical and commercial contributions.

tasks.title: Coordinate delivery
tasks.detail: Maintain relationships and track the commitments made in a contract.

roles.classroomConnection: A measurement becomes useful when its capabilities and limitations are communicated clearly to someone making a decision.

roles.title: Laboratory analysis and quality control
roles.summary: Prepare samples and check that analytical measurements can be trusted.
roles.explanation: Laboratory technicians follow procedures to prepare samples, use analytical instruments and record results. Calibration and quality checks help them identify unreliable readings before others use the data.

tasks.title: Prepare the test
tasks.detail: Prepare samples, reagents and standards according to a procedure.

tasks.title: Measure carefully
tasks.detail: Use analytical instruments with appropriate supervision and calibration.

tasks.title: Check and record
tasks.detail: Record results and follow quality and safety procedures.

roles.classroomConnection: Solution preparation, calibration and measurement quality connect classroom chemistry to testing real liquids.

roleRationale.why: For Printing press operator, this route supplies related preparation: Press setup, colour control, registration and production checks. It is a preparation connection, not a claim of the employer’s minimum qualification.

roleRationale.why: For Prosthetic and orthotic technician, this route supplies related preparation: Fabrication, repair, materials and collaboration with clinical practitioners. It is a preparation connection, not a claim of the employer’s minimum qualification.

pathways.learns: Material categories, contamination checks and material handling through workplace training.
